setup: One continuous 4-second shot picking up from @S23.end on the narrow stone stairwell landing of @SET-06, lit by one bare bulb. @CAST-05 Ines is centred-frame, backed against the heavy iron door, facing the lens at 35 mm with a handheld, urgent shake.

beats.camera: Handheld 35 mm, slight push-in, micro-shake; Ines fills the lower two-thirds of the frame, facing the lens.
beats.action: @CAST-05 Ines presses her back flat against the iron door, shoulders jerking; both hands rise into frame, fingers visibly trembling as she reaches for the lock.

beats.camera: Handheld drifts a few centimetres right to keep the hands centred; shake intensifies with her movement.
beats.action: Ines fumbles the @PROP-05 brass key on its loop of string, thumb slipping off the bow twice before she grips the loop; her mouth parts, lips tight with effort.

beats.camera: Handheld tilts down a few degrees to follow the falling key, then snaps back up to her face; shake stays constant.
beats.action: The @PROP-05 brass key slides from her shaking fingers and drops; Ines' hands snap open, empty, and her whole body stiffens against the door.

beats.camera: Handheld settles into a near-still hold at eye level, 35 mm, framing her face close; the last two seconds are a locked, breathing hold.
beats.action: Ines lifts her gaze straight into the lens; her tired dark eyes widen, the set of her jaw unclenches, and her lower lip trembles—a visible spike of terror held until the end of the take.

sound: Rapid, shallow breathing under a low 60 Hz hum from the bare bulb; the soft metallic clatter of the @PROP-05 brass key hitting the stone floor at 2.8 s; a faint creak of the iron door behind her; silence holds over her wide-eyed stare.
constraints: One continuous handheld take, no cuts.
